description: This file defines environment and path resolution utilities for the OpenClaw application, managing configuration and state directories, as well as environment variable overrides.

methods.name: path
methods.description: Retrieves an environment variable value for a given key, trims whitespace, and returns it as an optional string.

methods.name: stateDirURL
methods.description: Determines the URL for the application's state directory, checking environment variable overrides or defaulting to a directory in the user's home folder.

methods.name: resolveConfigCandidate
methods.description: Checks if a configuration file exists in a given directory, returning its URL if found.

methods.name: configURL
methods.description: Provides the URL to the application's configuration JSON, considering environment overrides or default locations.

methods.name: workspaceURL
methods.description: Constructs the URL for the workspace directory within the state directory.
